visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ accordion flowed into two columns
descriptions: Centered H2 and intro; 20 outlined rounded FAQ items in two columns with blue chevrons; decorative orange and teal arcs at the edges (decoration, not a background).

usage.description: 20 question/answer pairs laid out in two columns

reuseGuidance: Use for long FAQ lists; items are split evenly into two columns on desktop.
